name: Soukawa Ryuujirou
original_name: 双河 りゅうじろう
source:
A girl who was born alongside her twin brother, “[url=https://vndb.org/c133305]Ryuuichirou[/url]”, and given a boy's name. She blames herself for her brother getting into an accident, leaving him in a vegetative state.


[Taken from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2023/11/10/manimani/]Official Website[/url]]
